name: satamoni-neo
description: pnpm workspace: `pnpm install` at the root installs backend and frontend deps (one pnpm-lock.yaml).

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait postgres && pnpm --filter satamoni-neo-backend migrate
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter satamoni-neo-backend exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter satamoni-neo-frontend build
